head: hex
notes: Conflict. AMK B-12173 (cross-ref OEM 9427325) = #10 x 1/2 hex AB tapping screw w/ flat SEMS washer, phos & oil; camaros.net confirms 9427325 = AMK B-12173 (Camaro firewall gutter, captured washer). Paragon lists '450539 / 9427325' as 8-32 x 3/8 hex for Corvette defroster/heater cable brackets - possibly the 8-32 belongs to 450539. Finish from AMK.
